source_policy: Each repair gate has a distinct new ancestry root; failure of either leaves the other operational.
proof: Each rank-three fracture has unique mask m and eight crossing vectors. Losing bridge 1 requires bridge 2 to carry >=2/5 and vice versa. Positive independent bridges add nonnegative Laplacian contributions, hence no surviving mode can fall below 4/5. Enumerating all 28 distinct pairs per mask and applying the stated price rule yields exact minimum weighted sum per fracture.
limitations: Two newly independent roots are stipulated, not verified
A gate vector denotes a complete edge class, not a single physical link
Costs are synthetic unit prices, not real energy, dollars, or hardware
One new repair-root failure at a time following an original four-root fracture
Finite 16-node Cayley graph, not physical QCD
